column1: # Friction catalog for the proposal lane (bin/fm-proposal-lane.sh).
#   id <TAB> source <TAB> pattern <TAB> min_lines <TAB> min_tasks <TAB> repo <TAB> title <TAB> change <TAB> cost
#   captain  the durable operator preference record, data/captain.md
# pattern is an extended regular expression matched once per record line.
# A rule proposes only when at least min_lines lines match across at least
# min_tasks distinct sources, so a rule can never fire without evidence.
# Anchoring a status pattern on ^(blocked|paused|needs-decision) keeps its
# evidence to friction events rather than any line that mentions the subject.
# repo is the project the accepted work is filed against, or - for none.
# No field may contain a tab, and neither title, change, nor cost may contain a
# The catalog grows: add one line here to teach the lane a friction family it
# should propose on, and see docs/proposal-lane.md for the contract.

column7: Validation loses custody of a preserved head
column8: Make the validation pipeline offer its guarded recovery whenever the preserved head is provably present, instead of requiring a manual reconciliation.
column9: One bounded change in the pipeline status contract plus its tests.

column7: A repeated review family keeps re-opening after its correction
column8: Stop a repeated finding family deterministically after its one authorized correction instead of requiring a hand decision each round.
column9: One bounded change where a correction pass is recorded.

column7: Validation stops on a missing tool in its own environment
column8: Check the linters and runtimes a validation run needs before it starts and report the gap in one line.
column9: Small preflight check, no new dependency.

column7: The validation copy cannot be created from the submitted head
column8: Keep the submitted commit reachable for the whole run so the validation copy can always be created.
column9: One bounded change in the run's commit handling.

column7: Worker and supervisor disagree about their forge identity
column8: Compare the worker's and the supervisor's forge identity before a run and refuse with one line naming the divergence.
column9: Small preflight reusing the existing identity probes.

column7: Access to a secret or scope keeps blocking work
column8: Keep one durable record per blocked secret or scope with its request state, so a later task reuses an approved access instead of re-negotiating it.
column9: Small record addition, no new secret store.

column7: Finished work closes with an area nobody verified
column8: Require a closing task to name the unverified area and file it as a follow-up item instead of leaving it in the closing note.
column9: One line in the closing contract.

column7: The same manual step keeps coming back to the operator
column8: Prepare the exact command and its evidence once per step so it is run rather than rediscovered.
column9: Small preparation helper; the operator still runs the step.
